questionText: The most important factor that delayed the development of commerce in Nigeria was

options.D: that there were few developed markets

explanation: The unavailability of infrastructural facilities such as good roads, electricity, telecommunications, and ports was the most important factor that delayed the development of commerce in Nigeria.

questionText: Secondary production has to do with changing the

options.A: shape of raw materials through construction operation
options.B: physical form of raw materials into finished goods
options.C: utility of raw material by an engineering process
options.D: nature of raw materials through manufacturing

explanation: Secondary production involves manufacturing and construction processes that change the physical form of raw materials into finished goods. This includes all factory-based production activities.

questionText: The major responsibility of an entrepreneur is

options.A: employing all factors of production in the business
options.B: coordinating and determining the proportion of what to produce
options.C: planning and organizing all activities in the business
options.D: directing and controlling all the affairs of the business

explanation: The major responsibility of an entrepreneur is coordinating and determining the proportion of resources (factors of production) to combine and deciding what and how much to produce to meet market demand.

questionText: Which of the following best describe the scope of commerce?

options.A: All forms of commercial exchanges and the manufacturing industry
options.B: buying and selling and the construction industry
options.C: all occupational exchanges relating to industries and commercial activities
options.D: buying and selling as well as the extraction of natural resources

explanation: The scope of commerce encompasses all occupational exchanges relating to industries and commercial activities, including trade (buying and selling) and all the aids to trade that facilitate the exchange process.

questionText: Capital as a factor of production can be used as

options.A: money that is regarded as asset
options.B: goods that are useful in business

explanation: Capital as a factor of production refers to man-made goods (machinery, tools, equipment) that are used as inputs for further production of other goods and services.

questionText: The agency that currently oversee the privatization and commercialization processes in Nigeria is the

options.B: technical committee on privatization and commercialization

explanation: The Bureau of Public Enterprises (BPE) is the agency currently responsible for implementing and overseeing the privatization and commercialization of public enterprises in Nigeria.

questionText: Okeze contracted to sell TV sets to Ojo, unknown to them, the sets were stolen in transit. This contract may be terminated on the grounds of
explanation: This contract may be terminated on the grounds of frustration. Frustration occurs when an unforeseen event (such as the theft of goods in transit) makes the performance of a contract impossible through no fault of either party.

questionText: Which of the following countries are member of the lake Chad Basin Commission?
explanation: Nigeria is a member of the Lake Chad Basin Commission. The original member countries are Nigeria, Chad, Niger, and Cameroon. Benin and Mali are not members of this commission.

questionText: A core investor in the current phase of privatization in Nigeria is one who

options.A: can afford to buy most of the shares of the enterprises
options.B: will be at the core of the enterprises
options.C: can mobilize foreign currency equivalent to the value of the enterprises
options.D: has the technical know-how of the enterprises

explanation: A core investor in Nigeria's privatization process is one who has the technical know-how and management expertise needed to run the enterprise efficiently and profitably after privatization.

questionText: The agency in Nigeria which ensure that products conform to government quality specification is the
explanation: The Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) is the government agency responsible for ensuring that products manufactured in or imported into Nigeria conform to approved quality standards and specifications.

questionText: Awarding scholarships and sponsoring sports by a business organization are example of
explanation: Awarding scholarships and sponsoring sports are examples of corporate social responsibility (CSR). These activities demonstrate a business's commitment to giving back to the community and contributing to social development.

questionText: The commercialization of public enterprises is aimed at

options.A: increasing efficiency and making the enterprises self-sufficient
options.B: advertising and promoting the goods and services of the enterprise
options.C: increased assistance and patronage of the enterprises by the public
options.D: selling the goods and services of the enterprises

explanation: Commercialization of public enterprises aims to make them operate more efficiently and become self-sufficient by applying business principles and reducing dependency on government subsidies.

questionText: An author's exclusive right to his published and unpublished works is known as
explanation: Copyright is the exclusive legal right granted to an author over their published and unpublished literary, artistic, and creative works. It protects against unauthorized reproduction or distribution.

questionText: Under an endowment policy, the money handed over to the insured at the expiration of the stipulated time or at death is the
explanation: Under an endowment policy, the insured receives a lump sum benefit at the expiration of the policy term or upon death, whichever occurs first. This is the guaranteed payout of the policy.

questionText: The machine used for sending telex message is known as a
explanation: A teleprinter (teletypewriter) is the machine used to send and receive telex messages. It transmits typed messages over telephone lines to a receiving teleprinter at another location.

questionText: Which of these insurance principles requires a close connection between the actual loss suffered and the risk insured?
explanation: The principle of proximate cause requires that there be a close, direct connection between the actual loss suffered and the risk covered by the insurance policy. The loss must be caused by an insured peril.

questionText: The unit through which the results of a processed data are displayed is the
explanation: The output unit is the component of a computer system through which processed data (results) are displayed or presented to the user. Examples include monitors, printers, and speakers.

questionText: Which of the following is used to inform the addressee that a registered parcel is ready for collection?
explanation: A notification slip is sent by the post office to inform the addressee that a registered parcel has arrived and is ready for collection at the post office.

questionText: The type of computer commonly found in offices is
explanation: Desktop computers are the most commonly found type of computer in office environments due to their adequate processing power, affordability, and suitability for standard office tasks.

questionText: The mode of transporting crude oil to the ports for export purposes is by
explanation: Crude oil is transported to export ports primarily through pipelines. Pipelines are the most efficient, cost-effective, and safest means of transporting large volumes of crude oil over long distances.

questionText: The temporary insurance certificate issued to the insured before drawing up a policy is a
explanation: A cover note is a temporary certificate of insurance issued to provide immediate coverage while the formal policy document is being prepared. It serves as proof of insurance until the actual policy is ready.

questionText: The bulls and bears in the Stock Exchange market help to minimize

options.A: the number of shares and bonds sold
options.C: fluctuations in the prices of securities
options.D: the elasticity of the prices of securities

explanation: Bulls (who buy expecting prices to rise) and bears (who sell expecting prices to fall) help minimize price fluctuations in the stock market. Their competing activities create a balancing effect on security prices.

questionText: Debentures differ from shares in that

options.A: they are secured on the company's assets
options.B: ownership is open to the public
options.C: they form part of the capital of the business
options.D: rewards are usually paid out of profit

explanation: Debentures differ from shares in that they are typically secured against the company's assets. If the company defaults, debenture holders can claim the assets used as security, unlike shareholders.

questionText: The Stock Exchange is a market where

options.B: all types of securities are sold

explanation: The Stock Exchange is a market where long-term securities such as shares, bonds, and debentures are bought and sold. Short-term securities are traded in the money market.

questionText: A retail cooperative society aims at

options.B: cutting off the profits of middlemen
options.C: lending money to member at low interests

explanation: A retail cooperative society aims at cutting off the profits of middlemen by buying goods directly from manufacturers or wholesalers and selling to members at lower prices.

questionText: A bill of exchange already accepted can be discounted by the holder in
explanation: A holder of an accepted bill of exchange can discount it at his own bank to receive immediate cash. The bank deducts a discount charge and pays the balance to the holder.

questionText: The document issued by the seller which gives details of the goods he sells is known as
explanation: A catalogue is a document issued by the seller that gives comprehensive details of the goods available for sale, including descriptions, specifications, images, and prices.

questionText:
Given: I Retail, II export, III Transport, IV import, V Insurance, VI banking and finance insurance VII wholesale VIII communication.
Which of the above are aids to trade?
explanation: Aids to trade are services that facilitate the exchange of goods. From the list: Transport (III), Insurance (V), Banking and finance (VI), and Communication (VIII) are aids to trade. Retail, export, import, and wholesale are forms of trade itself.

questionText: The organizational structure that relates the positions of specialists to the line managers is called
explanation: The line and staff organizational structure combines line authority (direct chain of command) with staff specialists who advise and support the line managers with their expertise.

questionText: A wholesaler who possesses the title to the goods he sells is known as
explanation: A merchant wholesaler is one who buys goods outright from manufacturers, taking full title (ownership) of the goods, and then resells them to retailers for a profit.

questionText: An important principle of a good organizational structure is
explanation: Span of control is a fundamental principle of organizational structure that determines the number of subordinates a manager can effectively supervise. A well-defined span of control ensures efficient management.

questionText: A company that is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission only without being enlisted on the stock exchange is a
explanation: A limited (private) company is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission but is not listed on the stock exchange. Its shares are not available for public trading, unlike a public limited company.

questionText: A contract for the sale of goods involves the

options.A: producer, the seller and the buyer of goods
options.C: transfer of title to goods for money

explanation: A contract for the sale of goods involves the transfer of title (ownership) of goods from the seller to the buyer in exchange for money (consideration). This is the legal definition of a sale.

questionText: The total of the share capital which a company would be allowed to issue is known as
explanation: Nominal (authorised) capital is the maximum amount of share capital that a company is legally allowed to issue, as stated in its memorandum of association.

questionText: The process of mobilizing, engaging and maintaining workers to work for an organization is referred to as
explanation: Staffing is the comprehensive process of mobilizing, engaging, and maintaining workers in an organization. It encompasses recruitment, selection, placement, training, and retention of employees.

questionText: Recognized members of the Stock Exchange who buy and sell securities on their own behalf are known as
explanation: Jobbers are recognized members of the Stock Exchange who buy and sell securities on their own behalf (for their own account). Unlike brokers who act as agents for clients, jobbers deal in securities as principals.

questionText: Which of the following involves foreign trade?
explanation: Commodity markets involve the international trading of primary products and raw materials (such as cocoa, oil, and minerals) between countries, which constitutes foreign trade.

questionText: Which of the following is a function of employers' association?

options.A: Undertaking research on behalf of employees
options.D: dissemination of information through sponsored journals

explanation: One function of employers' associations is the dissemination of information through sponsored journals and publications to keep members informed about industry trends, regulations, and best practices.

questionText: Which of the following industries is normally located near the source of its raw materials?
explanation: Cement factories are normally located near limestone quarries (their primary raw material) because limestone is very bulky and heavy, making it expensive to transport over long distances.

questionText: One of the most important functions of marketing is

options.A: encouraging research activities to meet needs
options.B: creating classes of merchants among businessman
options.C: the extension of markets for businesses

explanation: One of the most important functions of marketing is encouraging research activities to identify and meet customer needs. Marketing research helps businesses understand what consumers want and develop products accordingly.

questionText: Securities on which the buyers are not issued with certificates are called
explanation: Inscribed securities (inscribed stock) are securities where ownership is recorded in a register maintained by the issuing body, and no physical certificates are issued to the buyers.

questionText: In product pricing, which of these elements needs more consideration than others?

options.B: the demography of the buyers of the product
options.C: the economic conditions in the market
options.D: the cost of producing the product

explanation: In product pricing, the cost of producing the product needs the most consideration because it determines the minimum price that must be charged to cover expenses and generate a profit.

questionText: The principal objectives of the Central Bank of Nigeria can be classified broadly into

options.A: banker's bank, lender of last resort and issuance of currency
options.B: service, currency management and financial intermediation
options.C: banking services, foreign exchange operations and open market operations
options.D: service monetary policy and developmental functions

explanation: The principal objectives of the Central Bank of Nigeria can be broadly classified into monetary policy functions (maintaining price stability, managing the currency) and developmental functions (promoting economic growth and financial system stability).

questionText: The letters E and OE stands for
explanation: E&OE stands for 'Errors and Omissions Excepted.' This phrase is commonly printed on invoices and other commercial documents to indicate that the seller reserves the right to correct any unintentional errors.

questionText: An important issue for consideration in the product element of the marketing mix is the

options.B: channel of distribution of the product
options.D: planning and development of the product

explanation: The product element of the marketing mix focuses on the planning and development of the product itself, including its design, features, quality, branding, and packaging to meet customer needs.

questionText: A group of companies is a collection of
explanation: A group of companies is a collection of subsidiary companies and their holding (parent) company. The holding company owns controlling shares in its subsidiaries.

questionText: Which of the following is an example of trade associations?
explanation: The National Farmer's Council is an example of a trade association. Trade associations are groups of people in the same trade or industry who come together to promote and protect their common interests.

questionText: Which of the following determines the quality of the goods that a retailer sells?

options.A: The mode of contract of sales
options.C: the regulations regarding sales in the area

explanation: The quality of goods that a retailer sells is primarily determined by the type of manufacturer who produces them. Reputable manufacturers produce higher quality goods than less established ones.

questionText: An advantage of hire purchase to the consumer is the
explanation: A key advantage of hire purchase to the consumer is the ability to take possession of goods and use them immediately while paying in installments over time, rather than waiting to save the full amount.

questionText: The founders shares are usually referred to as deferred shares because the holders

options.B: receive their dividends after other share holders
options.C: receive their dividends before other shareholders
options.D: Are not entitled to any dividends

explanation: Founders' shares are called deferred shares because the holders receive their dividends only after all other classes of shareholders (preference and ordinary) have been paid their dividends.
